facts.fact: Algeria's APS account says the official launch of operation of the trans-Saharan fibre backbone linking In Guezzam (Algeria) to the Arlit-Agadez region (Niger) was held at Assamaka on 6 October 2026, with capacity up to 100 Gbps from the start, built by Algerie Telecom and Niger Telecom; the document describes it as carrying data traffic between the two countries and does not say that Niger's international traffic runs over it.
